component: Calder Find Your Fit / Fitment Finder

corrections.baseline_requirement: Fitment tabs intentionally overlap the bottom of the hero; panel immediately bridges hero to light content.
corrections.observed: Current implementation is separated from the hero by a large Make We Support section and blank/light vertical space.
corrections.material_discrepancy: The defining hero→fitment overlap/composition is absent.
corrections.recommended_correction: Reposition the fitment component into the hero transition so tab top is approximately 70 px above the hero/light boundary in the 2048×682 reference coordinate system; remove unrelated intervening vertical separation from the reference composition.
corrections.acceptance_condition: At matched viewport/crop, fitment visually bridges hero and light section with tabs overlapping hero as in reference.

corrections.baseline_requirement: Reference shell ≈1904×373 px at x≈74, y≈207; tabs ≈92 px tall.
corrections.observed: Current shell is substantially taller in the browser capture and tabs are taller/blockier; content occupies more vertical space.
corrections.material_discrepancy: Component proportions do not reproduce the compact reference panel.
corrections.recommended_correction: Target reference shell aspect/proportions: width ≈93% of reference width, height ≈373 px at 2048 reference width; normalize tab height to ≈92 px and finder row to the lower third of panel.
corrections.acceptance_condition: Shell and tab proportions visually match reference within normal browser tolerance.

corrections.baseline_requirement: Tabs have distinctive angled/slanted adjoining geometry, thin outline, and active bronze lower accent.
corrections.observed: Current tabs are conventional rounded rectangles with a straight shared boundary.
corrections.material_discrepancy: A major signature shape from the approved mockup is missing.
corrections.recommended_correction: Reproduce the reference tab silhouettes: By Vehicle ≈349×92 px, By Wheel Style ≈387×92 px at reference scale, with angled adjoining edges and ≈3 px bronze active accent.
corrections.acceptance_condition: Tab silhouettes, overlap/join, border and active accent closely match reference.

corrections.baseline_requirement: Reference includes visible contour-flow lines plus a large technical wheel drawing spanning the center-right finder region.
corrections.observed: Current implementation screenshot shows essentially flat navy with no comparable technical wheel composition.
corrections.material_discrepancy: A major visual characteristic and center-panel balance is absent.
corrections.recommended_correction: Restore both artwork systems. Wheel line art should occupy roughly x≈1000–1518 and y≈207–500 at reference scale with restrained 16–28% perceived opacity/fade; contour lines should span approximately x≈650–1110.
corrections.acceptance_condition: Wheel and contour artwork are clearly perceptible at reference-like scale/placement but remain subordinate to controls.

corrections.baseline_requirement: Reference heading ≈52 px, description ≈20 px and single/two-line width ≈575 px; tab labels are smaller than current implementation.
corrections.observed: Current heading/tab typography and surrounding spacing are visibly larger/heavier relative to panel.
corrections.material_discrepancy: Typography changes visual weight and contributes to oversized component feel.
corrections.recommended_correction: Rebase typography to reference-derived scale and line-height; preserve bronze FIT and reference description wrapping.
corrections.acceptance_condition: Heading, description, tab labels and form typography match reference hierarchy and wrapping closely.

corrections.baseline_requirement: Reference controls share a 70 px height and differentiated widths: ≈201/217/218/249 px with gaps ≈27/25/27 px; CTA ≈365×80 px.
corrections.observed: Current controls are much wider due to distributing the row across nearly the entire shell, and CTA geometry differs.
corrections.material_discrepancy: Form rhythm and CTA relationship do not match the reference.
corrections.recommended_correction: Use reference-proportional individual widths rather than equal/flex-expanded fields; align all labels and controls to the reference baseline and set CTA to reference-proportional ≈365×80 px.
corrections.acceptance_condition: At matched reference scale, field widths, gaps, row baseline and CTA footprint closely reproduce reference.

corrections.baseline_requirement: Right vehicle region begins at x≈1521, width≈457 px, with vertical divider, title/status, horizontal divider and action separator.
corrections.observed: The supplied current browser screenshot is an unselected state and does not visually demonstrate the reference selected-vehicle composition.
corrections.material_discrepancy: High-fidelity conformance of a major reference region cannot be verified and the current visible layout devotes the full row to finder controls.
corrections.recommended_correction: Implement/verify selected state using the reference region geometry: ≈24% shell width, divider height ≈323 px, ≈55 px content inset, horizontal divider ≈355 px, separate Change Vehicle and Reset actions with small vertical separator.
corrections.acceptance_condition: Provide selected-state render matching reference geometry and styling.

corrections.baseline_requirement: Reference uses dark panel navy, darker CTA, brighter bronze outline/accent, medium-gray control borders and subtle gray structural dividers.
corrections.observed: Current implementation is broadly on-palette but controls/panel have flatter tonal separation and the CTA is disabled/dim in supplied state.
corrections.material_discrepancy: Surface contrast and bronze emphasis are weaker than reference.
corrections.recommended_correction: Tune surfaces toward sampled/estimated baseline colors and verify enabled CTA state against reference rather than disabled-state appearance.
corrections.acceptance_condition: Surface hierarchy and bronze/gray contrast visually match reference.
